title: Hyp Genus2 Height Perf
objective: Integrate a production modular/local genus-2 Kummer height path and benchmark accuracy-matched heights, pairings, and regulators against Magma.

handoff.summary: Added a certified bounded-state modular/dyadic genus-2 canonical-height path with a source-transparent arbitrary-Integer native recurrence, identical dynamic fallback, exact-small-step oracle, reusable model and point contexts, finite and archimedean tail certificates, and propagated height/pairing/regulator accuracy. Corrected the non-monic binary-sextic discriminant factor, bound all proof artifacts to the exact model, and added adversarial regressions plus an accuracy-matched resident Magma benchmark at 64, 128, and 256 target bits.
risks: The production local path currently covers primitive integral classical odd-degree quintics with h=0; generalized, rational-coefficient, and other models retain the guarded exact path.

Legacy Magma 2.18-5 prints a stable arbitrary-looking tail but agrees with the exact Kummer recurrence only through about 100 bits. The benchmark conservatively treats only its 96-bit prefix as an independent oracle; wider Sage.js certificates are theorem-backed and checked against the exact recurrence.

The new neutral kernel leaves hyperelliptic-curves-bsd 6,988 bytes over its current lazy budget in this lane. The integration lane owns the required production-kernel registry and package routing/budget adjustment; all later architecture checks otherwise reach this expected package gate.
Focused cross-platform runtime receipts remain to be collected on Windows x64, Linux arm64, and macOS arm64; the implementation is ordinary Python and introduces no native dependency.

The certified outward dyadic archimedean quartic recurrence is source-transparently compiled over caller-owned arbitrary-precision IntegerBuffers, with the identical typed Python body retained as its differential fallback. The remaining cold-time envelope requires quiet bench-1 acceptance measurements after integration registers the production kernel.
next_steps: Move immutable Flynn duplication tables and their generic evaluator into a neutral genus2_kummer_formulas module so both public prime-field Kummer arithmetic and the height layer depend downward without duplication.
When integrating automatic selection changes, preserve legacy resource-guard coverage by making the corresponding test request algorithm='exact' explicitly.
Collect focused runtime receipts on windows, bench-arm, and m1, then optimize only measured architecture-specific regressions.
Register the production kernel and package routing through the integration lane, then collect quiet accuracy-matched 64/128/256-bit Magma and Sage.js acceptance rows on bench-1.
